info.title: Multi-Tenant Workflow Platform
info.description:
Enterprise SaaS workflow platform: projects, tasks, sequential approvals, notifications and audit — with strict per-organization isolation enforced on the backend.

**Authentication:** call `/auth/login`, then `/auth/switch-organization` to get a token scoped to one organization. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

**Errors:** every error is `{"detail": str, "code": str}`. Cross-tenant IDs return 404.
